Title: Disable Windows Telemetry & Diagnostic Data Collection
Description: Stops Windows from collecting diagnostic telemetry, diagnostic logs, and sending background telemetry packets to Microsoft servers.
ApplyScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'AllowTelemetry' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Stop-Service 'DiagTrack' -WarningAction SilentlyContinue; Set-Service 'DiagTrack' -StartupType Disabled
RevertScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\DataCollection' -Name 'AllowTelemetry' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-Service 'DiagTrack' -StartupType Automatic; Start-Service 'DiagTrack' -WarningAction SilentlyContinue

Title: Disable Windows Telemetry Scheduled Tasks
Description: Disables background scheduled tasks that collect hardware metrics, application experience data, and CEIP diagnostic reports.
ApplyScript: $tasks = @('\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser', '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater', '\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip', '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector'); foreach ($t in $tasks) { Disable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
RevertScript: $tasks = @('\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\Microsoft Compatibility Appraiser', '\Microsoft\Windows\Application Experience\ProgramDataUpdater', '\Microsoft\Windows\Autochk\Proxy', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\Consolidator', '\Microsoft\Windows\Customer Experience Improvement Program\UsbCeip', '\Microsoft\Windows\DiskDiagnostic\Microsoft-Windows-DiskDiagnosticDataCollector'); foreach ($t in $tasks) { Enable-ScheduledTask -TaskName $t -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Title: Disable Advertising ID for Personalized Tracking
Description: Prevents Windows and third-party Store applications from tracking your app activities to serve targeted behavioral advertisements.

Title: Disable Windows Activity History & Timeline Tracking
Description: Prevents Windows from storing user timeline activities, opened documents, and syncing user history to cloud accounts.
ApplyScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'EnableActivityFeed' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'PublishUserActivities' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'UploadUserActivities' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force
RevertScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'EnableActivityFeed' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'PublishUserActivities' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\System' -Name 'UploadUserActivities' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force

Title: Disable Windows Location Tracking & Sensors
Description: Prevents background location sensors from tracking your physical coordinates and reporting geographic location to apps.

Title: Disable Windows Feedback Surveys & Prompts
Description: Sets Windows feedback frequency to 'Never', stopping intrusive question dialogs asking how satisfied you are with Windows features.
ApplyScript: New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules' -Name 'NumberOfSIUFInPeriod' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Siuf\Rules' -Name 'PeriodInNanoSeconds' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force

Title: Disable Tailored Experiences with Diagnostic Data
Description: Prevents Microsoft from using your diagnostic telemetry to show personalized recommendations, tips, and product offers.

Title: Disable Inking & Typing Personalization Data Collection
Description: Stops Windows from harvesting your keystroke patterns and handwriting samples to train cloud linguistic models.

Title: Disable Windows Copilot AI Integration
Description: Completely disables Microsoft Copilot AI from the Windows 11 taskbar, system hotkeys, and Windows Shell policies.
ApplyScript: New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Name 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Name 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'ShowCopilotButton' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force
RevertScript: Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Name 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsCopilot' -Name 'TurnOffWindowsCopilot' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Explorer\Advanced' -Name 'ShowCopilotButton' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force

Title: Disable Windows Recall & AI Snapshots
Description: Prevents Windows 11 Recall from constantly taking background screenshot snapshots of your screen and analyzing your private desktop content.
ApplyScript: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI' -Name 'DisableAIDataAnalysis' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\WindowsAI' -Name 'DisableAIDataAnalysis' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force

Title: Disable Windows Click To Do AI Context Actions
Description: Disables the generative AI Click To Do contextual overlay on Windows 11 24H2+, reducing background AI processing overhead.

Title: Disable Copilot & AI Sidebar in Microsoft Edge
Description: Removes the Copilot button and Bing AI sidebar completely from Microsoft Edge browser windows.
ApplyScript: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' -Name 'HubsSidebarEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Edge' -Name 'ShowCopilotButton' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force

Title: Disable Bing Search & Web Suggestions in Start Menu
Description: Prevents Start Menu search from querying Bing and showing online ads or web suggestions, making local file searches instant.
ApplyScript: New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Explorer' -Name 'DisableSearchBoxSuggestions' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Search' -Name 'BingSearchEnabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force

Title: Disable Search Highlights & Trending Content on Taskbar
Description: Disables cartoon doodles, trending web topics, and online clickbait in the taskbar search box.

Title: Disable Cortana Background Autostart & Search Integration
Description: Disables Cortana background voice indexing and legacy voice integration from executing in system memory.
ApplyScript: New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Windows Search' -Name 'AllowCortana' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force

Title: Disable Lock Screen Tips, Facts, & Spotlight Promotions
Description: Disables promotional tips, Bing links, and advertising overlays on the Windows lock screen.

Title: Disable Start Menu Recommendations & Promoted Store Apps
Description: Removes recommended files, suggested Microsoft Store apps, and sponsored tiles in the Windows 11 Start Menu.

Title: Disable Settings App Suggested Content & Ad Banners
Description: Blocks promotional banners, Game Pass upsells, and OneDrive subscription promos inside the Windows Settings app.
ApplyScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338393Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353694Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force
RevertScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-338393Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353694Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\ContentDeliveryManager' -Name 'SubscribedContent-353696Enabled' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force

Title: Disable File Explorer Sync Provider Notifications & OneDrive Ads
Description: Stops promotional ad banners for Microsoft 365 and OneDrive from appearing across the top of File Explorer windows.

Title: Disable 'Finish Setting Up Your Device' Fullscreen Nag Screens
Description: Blocks the annoying full-screen prompt asking you to link an Android phone, activate Edge, or subscribe to Office after updates.

Title: Disable Windows Notification Tips & Suggested Ways to Use Windows
Description: Silences system popups that offer tips, tricks, and suggestions when using your PC.

Title: Windows 11 Full Classic Right-Click Menu
Description: Restores the immediate full classic right-click context menu in Windows 11, completely eliminating the need to click 'Show more options'.

Title: Align Windows 11 Taskbar to Left (Classic Layout)
Description: Moves the Start button and pinned taskbar icons to the bottom-left corner of the screen like traditional Windows versions.

Title: Enable 'End Task' on Taskbar Right-Click Menu
Description: Adds an instant 'End Task' option directly to the taskbar icon right-click menu to quickly kill frozen apps without opening Task Manager.

Title: Hide Widgets & News from Taskbar
Description: Removes the Widgets / News & Weather icon from the taskbar to save RAM and eliminate MSN news distractors.

Title: Hide Microsoft Teams Chat Icon from Taskbar
Description: Removes the integrated consumer Teams Chat icon from the Windows 11 taskbar.

Title: Hide Task View Button from Taskbar
Description: Removes the Virtual Desktops Task View button from the taskbar for a cleaner layout (Win+Tab still functions).

Title: Disable Sticky Keys 5x Shift Shortcut Popup
Description: Prevents the annoying accessibility Sticky Keys popup from interrupting fullscreen games when pressing the Shift key rapidly.

Title: Disable Mouse Acceleration for 1:1 Raw Precision
Description: Disables 'Enhance Pointer Precision' to ensure mouse movement has a direct 1:1 linear mapping for gaming and precision editing.
ApplyScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Value '0' -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Value '0' -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Value '0' -Force
RevertScript: Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseSpeed' -Value '1' -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold1' -Value '6' -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Control Panel\Mouse' -Name 'MouseThreshold2' -Value '10' -Force

Title: Show Known File Extensions in File Explorer
Description: Always displays file extensions (.exe, .txt, .zip, etc.) so you can identify real file types and avoid malicious spoofed extensions.

Title: Show Hidden Files & Folders in File Explorer
Description: Displays hidden system files and folders like AppData in File Explorer.

Title: Open File Explorer to 'This PC' Instead of 'Home'
Description: Configures File Explorer to launch directly to 'This PC' showing your local hard drive letters and storage volumes immediately.

Title: Hide '3D Objects' Folder from This PC
Description: Removes the obsolete and unused '3D Objects' special folder from File Explorer and This PC.

Title: Hide 'Gallery' from File Explorer Navigation Pane
Description: Removes the cloud-synced Gallery shortcut icon from the left navigation pane in Windows 11 File Explorer.
ApplyScript: New-Item -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\CLSID\{e88865ea-0e1c-4e20-9aa6-ed304a74017b}' -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty -Path 'HKCU:\Software\Classes\CLSID\{e88865ea-0e1c-4e20-9aa6-ed304a74017b}' -Name 'System.IsPinnedToNameSpaceTree' -Type DWord -Value 0 -Force; Stop-Process -Name explorer -Force

Title: Hide Duplicate Removable Drive Letters from Navigation Pane
Description: Stops Windows from listing USB drives and portable storage twice in the File Explorer sidebar.

Title: Enable Ultimate Performance Power Plan
Description: Unlocks the hidden Ultimate Performance power scheme which eliminates micro-latencies and keeps CPU cores responsive for heavy workloads and gaming.

Title: Disable Xbox Game DVR Background Recording
Description: Disables background video capture for games, freeing up GPU encoding resources and increasing frame rates.

Title: Enable Hardware-Accelerated GPU Scheduling (HAGS)
Description: Allows the GPU to manage its own video memory directly, significantly reducing latency and improving game smoothness.

Title: Disable Network Throttling for Gaming & Media
Description: Windows limits non-multimedia network traffic to prevent packet flooding. Disabling it maximizes throughput and reduces ping in games.

Title: Disable Nagle's Algorithm (TcpAckFrequency & TCPNoDelay)
Description: Eliminates network buffering delays for TCP packets to minimize packet ping latency in online multiplayer games.
ApplyScript: $adapters = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\*'; foreach ($a in $adapters) { Set-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force; Set-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -Type DWord -Value 1 -Force }
RevertScript: $adapters = Get-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Tcpip\Parameters\Interfaces\*'; foreach ($a in $adapters) { Remove-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TcpAckFrequency' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-ItemProperty -Path $a.PSPath -Name 'TCPNoDelay' -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Title: Disable Windows Delivery Optimization P2P Internet Uploads
Description: Stops Windows from using your internet upload bandwidth to seed Windows updates to other computers across the internet.

Title: Disable Silent Background App Downloads from Microsoft Store
Description: Prevents Windows ContentDeliveryManager from automatically downloading promotional apps and games behind your back.

Title: Remove Pre-installed Consumer Bloatware & Sponsored Apps
Description: Silently uninstalls third-party pre-loaded store apps like TikTok, Disney, Candy Crush, Solitaire collection, and Spotify promo packages.
ApplyScript: $bloat = @('*CandyCrush*', '*TikTok*', '*Disney*', '*SpotifyAB*', '*Amazon*', '*Facebook*', '*Twitter*', '*EclipseManager*'); foreach ($app in $bloat) { Get-AppxPackage -Name $app -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
RevertScript: Write-Output 'Apps can be reinstalled from Microsoft Store if desired.'

Title: Remove Deprecated Cortana App
Description: Removes the standalone Cortana application which Microsoft has retired from Windows.

Title: Remove Feedback Hub & Tips
Description: Removes Windows Tips, Feedback Hub, and 'Get Help' background prompts.
ApplyScript: Get-AppxPackage -Name '*WindowsFeedbackHub*' -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-AppxPackage -Name '*GetHelp*' -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
RevertScript: Write-Output 'Can be reinstalled from Microsoft Store.'

Title: Remove 3D Viewer & Print 3D Packages
Description: Uninstalls 3D Viewer and Print 3D store apps that ship by default on Windows.
ApplyScript: Get-AppxPackage -Name '*Microsoft.Microsoft3DViewer*' -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Get-AppxPackage -Name '*Microsoft.Print3D*' -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Remove-AppxPackage -AllUsers -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
RevertScript: Write-Output 'Can be reinstalled from Microsoft Store.'

Title: Remove Mixed Reality Portal & Packages
Description: Removes Windows Mixed Reality Portal and associated VR runtime packages if you do not use a VR headset.
RevertScript: Write-Output 'Can be reinstalled from Microsoft Store.'
